meals.title: Your breakfast sandwich, rebuilt
meals.desc: Whole-grain English muffin, 1 egg + 2 whites, turkey sausage patty, tomato, dijon. The bagel was 300+ calories of white flour and the American cheese was pure saturated fat — this keeps everything you actually taste.

meals.title: Breakfast "fried rice," rebuilt
meals.desc: Half brown rice, half cauliflower rice (you won't notice), 1 egg + 2 whites, peas, carrots, scallions, 2 tsp sesame oil, low-sodium soy. Same flavor, half the starch, a third of the oil.

meals.title: Overnight oats
meals.desc: ½ cup oats, 1 tbsp chia, ¾ cup 2% Greek yogurt, berries, 8 walnut halves, cinnamon. Assemble the night before. The single best LDL breakfast there is — beta-glucan plus omega-3s.

meals.title: Savory oats with a soft egg
meals.desc: Oats cooked in chicken broth, topped with a jammy egg, scallions, chili crisp (1 tsp), sesame. Congee energy, five minutes. For the guy who'd rather not eat "dessert oatmeal."

meals.title: Huevos with black beans
meals.desc: 1 egg + 2 whites scrambled, ½ cup black beans, 2 corn tortillas, salsa, ⅛ avocado, cilantro. Beans at breakfast is a cheat code for the daily soluble-fiber target.

meals.title: Smoked salmon toast
meals.desc: 2 slices dense whole-grain toast, ¼ avocado mashed, 2 oz smoked salmon, tomato, capers, squeeze of lemon. Omega-3s before 9am.

meals.title: Greek yogurt power bowl
meals.desc: 1 cup 2% Greek yogurt, ½ cup berries, ¼ cup low-sugar granola, 1 tbsp sliced almonds, drizzle of honey. The fast option for rushed mornings.

meals.title: Gym-morning smoothie
meals.desc: Whey protein scoop, ¼ cup oats, ½ banana, frozen berries, handful of spinach, 1 tbsp peanut butter, water or unsweetened almond milk. Drinkable on the way to the gym.

meals.title: Big chicken & chickpea salad
meals.desc: 6 oz grilled chicken, ½ cup chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, red onion, feta (2 tbsp), olive-oil vinaigrette, over romaine with a small whole-grain roll.

meals.title: Chicken burrito bowl
meals.desc: ¾ cup brown rice, ½ cup black beans, 5 oz chicken, fajita peppers and onions, salsa, 2 tbsp guacamole, no cheese, no sour cream. Better than the restaurant version and 400 calories lighter.

meals.title: Tuna & white bean salad
meals.desc: 1 can tuna in olive oil (drained), ¾ cup cannellini beans, celery, red onion, parsley, lemon, over greens with whole-grain crackers. Zero cooking, omega-3s plus soluble fiber in one bowl.

meals.title: Asian chopped chicken salad
meals.desc: 5 oz chicken, shredded cabbage and carrots, ¾ cup edamame, mandarin segments, scallions, peanut-lime dressing (1½ tbsp peanut butter base), crushed peanuts.

meals.title: Turkey-avocado sandwich + soup
meals.desc: Whole-grain bread, 4 oz turkey, ¼ avocado instead of mayo, mustard, lettuce, tomato, plus a cup of minestrone or vegetable soup. The deli lunch, corrected.

meals.title: Lentil or black bean soup, upgraded
meals.desc: 2 cups hearty lentil or black bean soup (batch-cook Sunday), topped with Greek yogurt and hot sauce, side salad with vinaigrette, 1 slice whole-grain bread. The single biggest soluble-fiber meal in this guide.

meals.title: Chicken pita with hummus
meals.desc: Whole-wheat pita, 5 oz chicken, 3 tbsp hummus, cucumber-tomato salad with olive oil and lemon, pickled onions.

meals.title: Last night's dinner, boxed
meals.desc: Cook one extra portion at dinner and lunch handles itself. Every dinner below is sized so a full leftover portion fits the lunch slot.

meals.title: Chicken-vegetable stir fry
meals.desc: 6 oz chicken, 3 cups broccoli/peppers/snap peas, garlic-ginger sauce, 2 tsp oil in a hot wok, ¾ cup brown rice. The workhorse — swap in any protein and vegetable you have.

meals.title: Teriyaki salmon & edamame
meals.desc: 6 oz salmon glazed with reduced-sugar teriyaki, ¾ cup brown rice, steamed edamame, cucumber salad with rice vinegar. One of your two weekly fish dinners.

meals.title: Shrimp fried rice, rebuilt
meals.desc: Half brown rice, half cauliflower rice, 6 oz shrimp, 1 egg, peas, carrots, scallions, 1 tbsp oil total, soy and white pepper. Your favorite, engineered to fit the plan.

meals.title: Chicken fajitas
meals.desc: 6 oz chicken, charred peppers and onions, 3 corn tortillas, 2 tbsp guacamole, salsa, lime. Skip the cheese mound and sour cream — the char and lime do the work.

meals.title: Turkey & black bean chili
meals.desc: 93% lean ground turkey, two kinds of beans, fire-roasted tomatoes, real chili spices, topped with avocado and Greek yogurt. Batch-cook it — it's three dinners and two lunches.

meals.title: Fish tacos
meals.desc: 6 oz grilled cod or mahi with cumin and lime, 3 corn tortillas, cabbage slaw, yogurt-lime crema, pico de gallo. Fish dinner number two, disguised as taco night.

meals.title: Sheet-pan salmon & potatoes
meals.desc: 6 oz salmon, baby potatoes, broccoli, all roasted in olive oil with lemon and garlic. One pan, 25 minutes, nothing to think about.

meals.title: Whole-wheat pasta bolognese
meals.desc: 1½ cups whole-wheat pasta, sauce built on 93% lean turkey or half-lean-beef, plenty of tomato, splash of red wine in the pot (not the glass), big side salad. Pasta night survives — the portion and the noodle changed, not the ritual.

meals.title: Shrimp & white bean skillet
meals.desc: 6 oz shrimp, cannellini beans, cherry tomatoes, spinach, garlic, olive oil, chili flake, with a slice of grilled whole-grain bread to mop it up. 20 minutes.

meals.title: Grilled pork tenderloin plate
meals.desc: 6 oz pork tenderloin (as lean as chicken breast), roasted sweet potato, green beans with slivered almonds. Comfort food that needs no apology.

meals.title: Turkey burger & oven fries
meals.desc: 6 oz turkey burger on a whole-grain bun with all the fixings, potato wedges tossed in olive oil and roasted hot, vinegar slaw on the side.

meals.title: Steak night (once a week)
meals.desc: 5 oz sirloin or flank, baked potato with Greek yogurt and chives instead of butter and sour cream, asparagus. Red meat isn't banned — it's a weekly event with a lean cut.

meals.title: Apple + peanut butter
meals.desc: One apple, 1 tbsp natural peanut butter. Apple pectin is soluble fiber.

meals.title: The daily nuts
meals.desc: ¼ cup almonds or walnuts, measured, not from the bag. A daily handful of nuts is one of the best-proven LDL movers there is.

meals.title: Greek yogurt + berries
meals.desc: ¾ cup 2% Greek yogurt with a handful of berries. Also the answer when a dessert craving hits at 9pm.

meals.title: Hummus + vegetables
meals.desc: ¼ cup hummus with carrots, cucumber, and bell pepper strips.

meals.title: Edamame with flaky salt
meals.desc: 1 cup in-shell edamame, steamed from frozen in 4 minutes. Soy protein has its own modest LDL-lowering effect.

meals.title: Popcorn, air-popped
meals.desc: 4 cups air-popped, olive oil spray, salt or Tajín. Volume for when you want to eat a lot of something.

meals.title: Dark chocolate + almonds
meals.desc: 2 squares of 85% dark chocolate with 6 almonds. The planned sweet — see the Alcohol & Sweets tab for how this fits the dessert strategy.

meals.title: Cottage cheese + pineapple
meals.desc: ¾ cup low-fat cottage cheese with ⅓ cup pineapple. Old school, high protein, works.
